basic_details.job_title: Gaya District Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for 3 contractual posts – one each of Stenographer, Clerk and Peon/Orderly – in the Evening Court, Gaya. The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Gaya. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Gaya, either personally or through registered post, on or before 10 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About Civil Court Gaya Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Gaya, and is signed by Dr. Rakesh Kumar Singh - I, Principal District & Sessions Judge, Gaya, on 23.11.2026. The support staff will work in the Evening Court set up in the Gaya Judgeship. The notice is to be circulated to all Judgeships of Bihar. The notice follows a meeting on the functioning of the Evening Court held on 21 November 2026 in the chamber of the Ld. District & Additional Sessions Judge-XI, Gaya, attended by the Ld. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gaya, and the I/c Ld. Civil Judge (Sr. Div.) - I -cum- A.C.J.M. - I, Gaya. The meeting resolved that a notice inviting applications for support staff for the Evening Court may be issued with the terms set out below.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to: Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Gaya . The notice prints no further postal address details (street or PIN code). Mode: either personally (by hand) or through registered post. Deadline: the application must reach the office on or before 10 December 2026. In the application, mention your date of posting, last place of posting/working and date of retirement. Enclose a self-attested undertaking (see Enclosures below). The notice does not prescribe an application form format or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired court employees who have retired within the preceding three years, prior to the period as per guidelines issued by Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Civil Court Gaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly for the Evening Court, Gaya.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Gaya, on or before 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Gaya Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply. They must have satisfactory service records and no major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed for the Stenographer and Clerk posts?
faq.answer: The Stenographer must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. The Clerk must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice prints no amount; remuneration, the period of engagement and other conditions are governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Civil Court Gaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application to the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Gaya, either personally or through registered post, so that it reaches by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What details must the application contain?
faq.answer: The application must mention your date of posting, last place of posting/working and date of retirement, along with a self-attested undertaking that no major departmental proceeding has been initiated or is pending against you during service.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for the Evening Court and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. When will the selected staff work?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must perform their duties during the prescribed working hours of the Evening Court, Gaya.
